research_findings: Discovered an explicit TODO to add rate-limiting for the waitlist signup before heavy traffic.
Upstash Redis and Ratelimit packages were available and added to the project.
Identified that environment variables like UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL and UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN must be checked in scripts/check-env.ts, without failing the CI/CD build if they are absent.
Noted that in Next.js 15, the headers() function in Server Actions is asynchronous.
features_improved: Refactored scripts/check-env.ts to include check for Upstash rate limit variables conditionally.
Enhanced the waitlist module by implementing rate-limiting logic on incoming requests based on user IP address.
new_features_added: Integrated Upstash Rate Limiter into the application for API rate limiting.
next_steps_for_next_run: Implement Upstash caching or Redis caching across other heavy hit API endpoints.
Audit other actions for potential rate limiting needs.
